inputs.original_text: Another day another overreach from globalist bodies like the OSCE. Their 2026 report on France pretends to care about antisemitism while really targeting MIVILUDES for supposed lack of transparency. These delegates are demanding that France soften its strict secularism because it supposedly discriminates against fringe groups like the Scientologists and Jehovah's Witnesses. Court rulings against the French state body prove these so-called human rights standards are just tools to erode national authority and tear down cultural continuity. France should ignore the outsiders and double down on its own vigilance to protect legitimate traditions from foreign meddling.

France must shut out the outsiders and strengthen its own vigilance to defend legitimate traditions from this kind of foreign interference.
